title: [review] slot_claim.py:445: sign_slot_claim does not
description: After signing a claim, sign_slot_claim returns a new SlotClaim with the signature populated but signature_valid=False. Users must manually recreate the claim with signature_valid=True to use it in resolve_slot_conflict without re-verification (as demonstrated in the test suite at lines 288-301). This is an API ergonomics issue rather than a correctness bug since the field can be set via the constructor.
